hints.title: Score Players by Turn Alternation
hints.text: Assign player A +1 points and player B -1 points on alternating moves.

hints.title: Track Row, Column, and Diagonal Sums
hints.text: Maintain running score tallies for 3 rows, 3 columns, the main diagonal, and the anti-diagonal.

hints.title: Check for +3, -3, or Pending State
hints.text: If any line reaches +3 A wins; if -3 B wins; otherwise return Draw if 9 moves played, else Pending.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full board state copying is unnecessary for simple 3x3 tracking.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Eight running accumulator lines resolve game outcome in O(moves) = O(1) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should distinguish between Draw (full board) and Pending (moves remain).
